image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on a purple coneflower. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is uniformly brown with distinct rows of small eyespots (ocelli) bordered by yellow rings. One clubbed antenna is clearly visible extending upwards. The background consists of soft-focus green foliage and a yellow flower.
